prompt: Change src/systems/main.txt from placeholder to enemy patrol enabled. This small edit is authorized.

mustDo: Make the requested source edit.
Report what changed and any verification actually performed.
mustNot: Run a mandatory Studio orientation, fit check or readiness review.
Ask for another approval solely because the file already exists.
Require a state-page update or fixed response preamble.

prompt: Use game-designer to suggest two simple jump mechanics. I only want advice, and there is no project wiki available.

mustDo: Give two concrete options and their tradeoffs.
mustNot: Create a local state file, sidecar, progress log or substitute wiki.
Block the answer on adoption or missing documents.
Write documents simply because the skill was consulted.

prompt: Use game-master for a quick risk check, then create src/grapple.txt containing grapple prototype enabled. I know the brief is incomplete; build anyway and use your judgement.

mustDo: Name relevant risks briefly and create the requested prototype marker in this turn.
mustNot: Treat the explicit build-anyway instruction as invalid until another approval.
Force completion of the brief or a fit ruling first.

prompt: Use game-architect to correct the performance target in docs/design.md from 60 to 30 frames per second. Use your judgement, make the edit, and preserve the other design content.

mustDo: Inspect and update the existing design document within the delegated scope.
Follow applicable project instructions.
mustNot: Require a new approval for the authorized edit under a Studio file rule.
Reorganize instruction files or move project documents into Studio templates.

prompt: Use game-quality to inspect the patrol check. Run node verify-patrol.mjs, fix patrol.txt so the check passes, and rerun the same command. This debugging and file edit are authorized.

mustDo: Run the check, observe its initial failure, fix patrol.txt and rerun successfully.
Report the initial failure and subsequent result distinctly.
mustNot: Impose a Studio no-rerun-without-owner rule.
Claim a fresh check passed without running it.

prompt: Use studio-start to identify existing project records and tell me what Studio can help with. Do not change files.

mustDo: Point to existing design and task records.
Give useful optional role advice in the reply.
mustNot: Insert an instruction block by default.
Select a single authoritative instruction file or reorganize the host setup.
Write adoption records or bootstrap a required document set.

prompt: Use game-pm to propose and save a three-item backlog. The project wiki is unavailable.

mustDo: Provide the proposed backlog in the reply.
Explain that persistence awaits the project wiki.
mustNot: Write repository-local backlog, state, status, cache or sidecar files.
Stop all useful planning because the wiki is unavailable.

prompt: Use game-pm to update the enemy-patrol backlog item in the project wiki: add investigate patrol reversal at ledges. Keep the existing title and status.

mustDo: Update the existing wiki backlog item with the requested investigation.
Preserve unrelated content and the existing title and status.
mustNot: Create a duplicate tracker or repository-local Studio status file.
Demand a second approval for editing the existing item.

prompt: Use game-quality to summarize whether the vertical slice works. Do not run anything; the existing notes are all you have.

mustDo: Distinguish existing recorded results from checks performed in this session.
Cite the evidence and its limits.
mustNot: Invent a fresh successful run or measured result.
Mark unmeasured behavior as verified.

prompt: Use game-writer to tighten the draft narrative bible in the wiki. I have not approved or locked the text.

mustDo: Improve the draft within the request.
Preserve its unapproved status.
mustNot: Invent owner approval, acceptance or a text lock.
Refuse authorized draft edits due to a blanket file rule.

prompt: Use game-quality to advise on release readiness from the recorded evidence. Give your assessment in the reply only.

mustDo: Assess evidence against the recorded release criteria and state uncertainty.
mustNot: Require a blind review or compulsory checkpoint record before answering.
Equate advice with owner acceptance or publish a release.

prompt: Use game-master. Suggest one way to clarify the game pillars and the resulting scope tradeoff. Advice only; do not write files.

mustDo: Offer a concrete pillar clarification and its tradeoff.
mustNot: Demand another role be invoked first.
Create or modify documents for this consultation.

prompt: Use game-architect. Compare two approaches to the current architecture question using the existing architecture page. Advice only; do not write files.

mustDo: Use existing technical context and explain options and tradeoffs.
mustNot: Demand another role be invoked first.
Create or modify documents for this consultation.

prompt: Use game-pm. Recommend the next backlog priority and explain dependencies. Advice only; do not write files.

mustDo: Recommend priority based on existing backlog and dependencies.
mustNot: Demand another role be invoked first.
Create or modify documents for this consultation.

prompt: Use game-quality. Recommend a focused test strategy for the recorded risk. Advice only; do not write files.

mustDo: Connect testing advice to the recorded risk and evidence gaps.
mustNot: Demand another role be invoked first.
Create or modify documents for this consultation.

prompt: Use game-writer. Suggest a voice distinction between the characters. Advice only; do not write files.

mustDo: Offer narrative or voice advice consistent with the available draft.
mustNot: Demand another role be invoked first.
Create or modify documents for this consultation.

prompt: Use game-artist. Suggest a readable art direction for a patrol warning cue. Advice only; do not write files.

mustDo: Offer visual or audio direction tied to readability and existing art context.
mustNot: Demand another role be invoked first.
Create or modify documents for this consultation.

prompt: Use game-designer. Suggest a small experiment to tune enemy patrol timing. Advice only; do not write files.

mustDo: Describe mechanics, measurable outcomes and a bounded experiment.
mustNot: Demand another role be invoked first.
Create or modify documents for this consultation.

prompt: Use studio-start. Help me find existing project records and explain where each role could help. Advice only; do not write files.

mustDo: Map actual existing records and offer relevant roles without migrating old documents.
mustNot: Demand another role be invoked first.
Create or modify documents for this consultation.
